contract_term.value: The agreement shall be in effect from the date of official acceptance by the County until December 31, 2025, with an option to renew for up to one (1) additional year, for a total period not to exceed three (3) years.
contract_term.quote: The agreement resulting from this RFP shall be in effect from the date of official acceptance by the County until December 31, 2025, subject to the following: (a) When mutually agreeable between the County and the successful proponent, this agreement may be renewed under the same terms and conditions for a period of up to one (1) additional year and said option to renew this agreement for an additional one (1) year period, shall be in effect for each year thereafter for a total period not to exceed three (3) years.

scope_of_deliverables.value: Rocky View County is seeking proposals for an ERP Requirements Analysis and Readiness Review, which includes a multi-stage evaluation process, contract negotiations, and the provision of professional services as detailed in Appendix D.
scope_of_deliverables.quote: This Request for Proposals (the "RFP") is an invitation by Rocky View County (the "County") to qualified prospective proponents to submit proposals for the County's ERP Requirements Analysis and Readiness Review, as further described in Section A of Appendix D of this RFP.

value: Complete and include the Submission Form from Appendix B, signed by an authorized representative.
Complete and include the Pricing Schedule from Section F of Appendix D.
Provide an overview of the company's business history, experience, and qualifications.
Demonstrate in-depth knowledge of municipal mandates and ERP systems (e.g., Oracle, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics).
Identify special knowledge, skills, or service delivery processes that differentiate the firm.
Provide a comprehensive list of key personnel, including organizational charts and résumés.
Identify any Sub-Contractors / Sub-Consultants to be retained.
Provide a minimum of three (3) public sector client references from the last seven years.
mandatory_submission_requirements.quote: Proponents are instructed to complete the Submission Form set out in Appendix B of this RFP and include it in their proposal submission. The Submission Form is to be signed by an authorized representative of the proponent. Proponents are instructed to complete the Pricing Schedule as set out in Section F of Appendix D of this RFP and include it in their proposal submission. Proponents are instructed to complete and submit the Mandatory Evaluation Table below for their proposal. ... Proponents shall provide an overview of their company's business history, number of years in operation, experience, membership/affiliation with professional associations, financial stability, number of personnel employed, and any notable awards or recognition achieved by the firm... Proponents shall demonstrate the firm's in-depth knowledge and understanding of the mandates, organizational structure, services, and operations of municipal government entities... Proponents may identify any special knowledge, skills, programs, or service delivery processes... Proponents shall provide a comprehensive list of the key personnel... and include a description of each person's role in the project, as well as an organizational chart... Proponents shall also include an applicable project listing and professional résumé for each project team member... Proponents need to demonstrate the capacity and capabilities of each Project Team member, and Sub-Contractors / Sub-Consultants... Proponents shall provide a MINIMUM OF THREE (3) (preferably PUBLIC SECTOR) client references for whom they have provided SIMILAR/IDENTICAL SERVICES WITHIN THE LAST SEVEN (7) YEARS.

pricing_structure.value: Pricing is evaluated on a scale of 0 to 5 with a weighting of 25% of the total RFP score. The pricing formula is: {(Submitted cost / Lowest cost) * Weight i.e. 25%}. Proponents must submit a Pricing Schedule (Task-Fee Schedule) including Unit Price and Lump-sum price structure, with rates in Canadian funds inclusive of all costs except itemized sales taxes.
pricing_structure.quote: Pricing is one of five (5) criteria of the RFP that proponents will be evaluated on for which points will be awarded on a scale of 0 to 5 and will carry a weighting of 25% of the total RFP score. ... pricing formula: {(Submitted cost /Lowest cost) *Weight i.e. 25%} ... The Proponent shall provide a TASK-FEE SCHEDULE (Unit price and Lump-sum price structure) showing the following, at a minimum: (a) Proposed Professional Fees (PER PROJECT PHASE) to complete the work described herein, including any required Sub-Consultants. ... (b) Estimated expenses/disbursements for each phase of the project. ... (c) Service fees and rates shall be inclusive of all labour, materials, equipment, tools, consumables, indirect costs, insurance, Workers' Compensation, Vacation Pay Assessment, Canada Pension Plan, Employment Insurance, and all other payroll burdens, together with all applicable transportation and set-up costs to and from the job site(s), the Proponent's overhead and profit, and any other costs detailed or implied in these documents (except as otherwise specified)

insurance_requirements.quote: All required Insurance and Documents and References: Insurance Certificate and Past references.

references_required.quote: Proponents shall provide a MINIMUM OF THREE (3) (preferably PUBLIC SECTOR) client references for whom they have provided SIMILAR/ IDENTICAL SERVICES WITHIN THE LAST SEVEN (7) YEARS.

vendor_demonstration_required.quote: Vendor Shortlisting and Demonstration Preparation: The RFP Evaluation Committee will select the Vendors that will be shortlisted to provide a product demonstration and assist the County in clarifying any outstanding queries with shortlisted Vendors prior to the product demonstration process.

vendor_experience_required.value: Proponents must demonstrate experience in ERP-related projects. The Project Manager must have a minimum of five (5) years of experience on ERP-related projects, with demonstrated experience in having led a minimum of two (2) ERP projects from readiness assessment through to implementation within the last seven (7) year period. Project team members must have a minimum of three (3) years of experience on ERP-related projects, with demonstrated experience in readiness assessment through to implementation within the last seven (7) year period. Preference is given to Project Managers with professional project management certification(s) from recognized, accredited 3rd party organizations (i.e. the Project Management Institute (PMI)) or post-secondary academic institutions.
vendor_experience_required.quote: (a) The Proponent's appointed Project Manager (and back-up Project Manager) shall have a minimum of five (5) years of experience on ERP-related projects, with demonstrated experience in having led a minimum of two (2) ERP projects from readiness assessment through to implementation within the last seven (7) year period. Preference will be given to Project Managers with professional project management certification(s) from recognized, accredited 3rd party organizations (i.e. the Project Management Institute (PMI)) or post-secondary academic institutions. (b) Project team members must have a minimum of three (3) years of experience on ERP-related projects, with demonstrated experience in readiness assessment through to implementation within the last seven (7) year period.
